column1: # type: container, http, path, systemd-user-timer, git-clean, command
# severity (optional 4th column): info, warning, critical. Defaults to
# "warning" when omitted. See config/severity_map.json for the meaning of
# each level and scripts/lib/watchdog_severity.py for how it's applied.
# target may use ${VAR} placeholders (e.g. ${FRIGATE_HOST_IP}) for any
# variable defined in config/watchdog_known_hosts.conf - update the IP
# there, not here, when a box's address changes.
# Nightly restic backups: each machine writes /var/lib/host-backup/status.json; these read it and
# complain when any repository has had no good backup for 50 hours. See runbooks/backup-problem.md.
